datasets.name: Existing IceCream exact CPU clips, read-only

preserved_inputs: Clip: every48-byte uniform is the exact authored three-by-four clip matrix; original rectangular dimensions, pixel origins, IDs, instances, clear(-1,-1,-1,-1), triangle count, entry pair, layouts and rgba32float target are preserved.

VS: the exact2736-byte u blob and384000-byte objects blob, layouts/minimum sizes, uniform/storage/probe buffers, both bind groups, original per-job uniforms, selectors/IDs, readback pixel and four finite lanes are preserved.

No expected numerical image rule is introduced: these diagnostic outputs retain their original all-finite checks. Driver parity is exact in all448raw u32 lanes, every original observation field, browser/device/format/extent metadata and each source/resource hash.
The independent IEEE754 oracle now recursively recodes clip/ID/selector metadata into exact binary64 words. It still performs numerical decoding only; Coax invokes it and owns the comparison.

VS_source_epoch.difference: Current source adds canonical capsule directions, corrected box winding and their checks. The frozen96-job WGSL/fixture predates those changes.
VS_source_epoch.snapshot: raw/historical-source; historical production source copied there, never restored over current production.
VS_source_epoch.explicit_snapshot_behavior: --source-root selects which actual files are checked against every unchanged declared source hash. It does not rewrite expected hashes. The Coax result explicitly records the canonical source_root and exact input hashes.
VS_source_epoch.claim: This proves the executor switch on the exact historical inputs. It does not qualify current production VS output, an application image or a newly built producer.
